actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wererat makes two attacks, using

actions.name: Scratch or Hand Crossbow in any combination
actions.description: It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll:
+5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Wererat under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this wererat's curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6
+ 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description:
Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6
+ 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.description: The wererat shape-shifts into a Medium

bonus_actions.name: rat-humanoid hybrid or a Small rat, or it returns to its true humanoid form
bonus_actions.description: Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
